increment_basis.observer: boundary scans (flags), sampled AdamW, ledger, chunked reference comparison buffers (<= ~0.4 GiB) at low-memory points

time.expected_case_s: 150-200 (+ reference write ~30 s or compare ~40 s)

status_of_numbers: historical values are measurements of the identical recipe with OLDER instrumentation: lower bounds for the new code, not upper bounds; increments are estimates; the analytic values are lower bounds
not_bounded_by_allocator: set_per_process_memory_fraction limits only the caching allocator; CUDA context, cuBLAS/NCCL workspaces and foreach temporaries above the cap would raise OOM, not exceed the device
rule: fraction = smallest 0.01 step f with f x torch_total >= 1.02 x predicted_reserved, capped at 0.92; eligible iff predicted_reserved <= 0.92 x torch_total AND whole-device headroom (torch_total - f x torch_total - non-allocator) >= 2 GiB; 'thin margin' if f x torch_total - predicted_reserved < 0.5 GiB (relies on allocator cache release; an OOM stops the window)
